0.original: Qhoterl Pasol would send you on an errand to Slitherbough.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Use the fertilizer at the vegetable plots.

26.original: Deliver the vegetables to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: Thanks to Master Valan's kind introduction, we were able to establish friendly relations with the good folk of Slitherbough.

49.original: To mark the occasion, we presented them with our special fertilizer. So happy were they with the gift, they asked if they could have more!

50.original: Oh yes, we now have an arrangement in place where we provide fertilizer to the settlement in exchange for fresh vegetables.

51.original: If you're not otherwise occupied, <hex:020815E905FF094D69737472657373FF074D617374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, would you mind taking some fertilizer and using it on the crops at Slitherbough? When you have finished, please report to a woman named Ersabel.

52.original: Qhoterl Pasol sent you to fertilize our crops, did she? My thanks for your trouble.

53.original: I know not how the Qitari make the stuff, but in all my years, I've not seen any fertilizer work as effectively as theirs.

54.original: It makes our vegetables grow like a charm, and we're all too happy to share the harvest with our Qitari friends. Please see this delivered to them.

55.original: My thanks again for the fertilizer. Please see that the vegetables are delivered to Qhoterl Pasol.

56.original: Welcome back, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. May I ask if you have the vegetables?

57.original: My, such splendid crops these are, fairly bursting with the land's vitality! They're a blessing from Dalan Himself!

58.original: Everyone will be overjoyed for this treat─my dear husband not least of all!
